title: Coiling
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Gully coils rope for four panels. Wood draws his hands. It's the first strip that's only hands. The uncle looks over and says nothing, which is the review.

panels.composition: GULLY's hands, coiling wet line over elbow and palm. Nothing else.

image.prompt: close on a teenager's hands coiling wet rope over elbow and palm, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The coil growing. The hands. A thumb pressing the loop flat.

image.prompt: close on hands pressing a loop of rope flat onto a growing coil, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD's hand, drawing, the pad's corner. The pen following the rope.

image.prompt: close on a young man's hand drawing with a pen following the curve of a rope on a pad, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The UNCLE at the shack door, looking at the pad over Wood's shoulder. Saying nothing. Going back in.

image.prompt: an old man in a rain hood looking over a young man's shoulder at a drawing pad, then turning back into a shack doorway, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Only hands. The uncle's silence is the review.
